title: CreateFilterRequest
description: CreateFilterRequest schema from Amazon GuardDuty API

allOf.description: The name of the filter. Valid characters include period (.), underscore (_), dash (-), and alphanumeric characters. A whitespace is considered to be an invalid character.

The description of the filter. Valid characters include alphanumeric characters, and special characters such as hyphen, period, colon, underscore, parentheses ({ }, [ ], and ( )), forward slash, horizontal tab, vertical tab, newline, form feed, return, and whitespace.
Specifies the action that is to be applied to the findings that match the filter.
Specifies the position of the filter in the list of current filters. Also specifies the order in which this filter is applied to the findings.

Represents the criteria to be used in the filter for querying findings.
